sources.used: A2 nominal gain 20; 1.1 MHz typical bandwidth; offset 15 uV maximum and input bias 25/35/45 uA minimum/typical/maximum under specified conditions; full-temperature maximum IQ 3.2 mA.
sources.limits: These values are not a complete joint bound over common-mode voltage, temperature, power state and transient waveform. One-pole response and output clamps in this study are assumptions.

sources.used: DCK electrical table: 45 uV maximum input offset at specified conditions; 1 MHz typical gain-bandwidth product. Model buffer response uses a 450 kHz one-pole assumption informed by the unity-gain bandwidth entry, not a guaranteed settling envelope.
sources.limits: DC gain 1e6, hard output limits 0.05/4.95 V, passive buffer surrogate, no slew/overload/phase-margin model. DBV was marked preview; native cell is revised separately to production DCK pinout and SOT-353 footprint.
Orderable part status is not implant or chronic qualification.

sources.used: 16 bit; input measurement range 0 to VREF; INL +/-2 LSB maximum; aperture delay 4 ns typical; conversion time maximum 8.8 us under stated timing conditions.
sources.limits: Electrical min/max conditions include AVDD=DVDD=3 V and VREF=5 V. Native 3.3 V/4.096 V point needs separate characterization. Quantizer includes nearest rounding and a selected gain corner, not complete INL/offset/noise. No SAR kickback or reference-current model. 9.8 us read availability is a scheduling assumption.

sources.used: 5 V table typical charge injection -6 pC under its test conditions motivates a magnitude stress.
sources.limits: Positive 6 pC injected into summing node 1 us after reset opens is a deliberate model experiment, not a reproduction of the manufacturer's sign, distribution, timing or maximum. Reset Ron=2 ohm, Roff=1e12 ohm and 1 ns transition are assumptions.

sources.used: Synchronous shared-library API used by the independent adapter.
sources.limits: API provenance only; does not validate the circuit model.

assumptions.artificial_load: Ideal commanded current is filtered by an assumed first-order driver response and injected into a two-ohm return shunt held near 48 V. No output-driver servo, anatomical return or electrode chemistry is represented.
assumptions.independent_sources: Two uncoupled electrical channels with opposite first phase and 25 us start staggering; no shared-supply, common-return or tissue coupling qualification.
assumptions.nominal_waveform: 3 mA, 200 us command phases, 100 us gap, 1 ns command ramps; 100 ns assumed load-current time constant.
assumptions.passive_buffer: 1 ohm / C=1/(2*pi*450kHz) passive low-pass is loaded by the actual 33 ohm/1 nF ADC filter; analytical oracle includes that coupling.
assumptions.finite_gain_integrator: A0=1e6 and one-pole GBW=1 MHz, 10 kohm input, 22 nF feedback, 1e12 ohm parallel leak nominal. 10 Mohm leak is a stress, not a component prediction.
assumptions.error_corner: 2.002 ohm shunt, gain 20.002, 9990 ohm input, 21.89 nF feedback, +15 uV sensor input offset, +45 uV integrator input offset, +0.01% ADC gain are a constructed deterministic corner; not a guaranteed joint distribution or full PVT bound.
assumptions.clock_strip: Start shifted by s and end by -s for s in +/-1 us, +/-100 ns and zero: symmetric interval expansion/contraction only; no independent endpoint uncertainty proof.
assumptions.fault: 40 mA/500 us phases deliberately exceed admitted current/charge domain; metadata forces bypass. Shutdown hardware is not simulated. Continuing beyond ADC range is a mathematical fault witness, not a device survival prediction.
